title: Subtracting Decimals

copy.studentInstructions: Subtract the decimals. Line up the decimal places and mark the matching answer in the called column. Complete the winning pattern, then call MATHO!
copy.roomIntro: Subtract numbers below 10 with two decimal places. All answers are zero or positive. Columns progress from no regrouping to borrowing across zero. Choose your winning pattern below.
copy.callerHeading: Line them up. Work it out.
copy.callerSubtitle: Subtract the decimals. Find your answer. Call MATHO!
copy.joinIntro: Get your teacher’s code. Let’s subtract!
copy.footer: Line up the decimals. Find your square.
copy.bankIntro: 50 questions, all using numbers below 10 with two decimal places and nonnegative answers. M: no borrowing. A: borrow for hundredths. T: borrow from the ones. H: borrow in both places. O: borrow across a zero in the tenths place. Signed-in edits save to your private teacher library.
